description: Ghostty: free Dracula theme, Hack Nerd Font, a translucent window, macOS-style keys

hint.linux: sudo apt install ghostty (Ubuntu 26.04 or newer), or your distribution's package: https://ghostty.org/docs/install/binary

hint.macos: brew install --cask font-hack-nerd-font (Ghostty's font; without it Ghostty uses its own)
hint.linux: Hack from https://www.nerdfonts.com/font-downloads, unpacked into ~/.local/share/fonts (Ghostty's font; without it Ghostty uses its own)
